title: A + Ā·B covers the same region as A + B
caption: In the Venn diagram A together with the part of B outside A is the same region as A ∪ B: the shaded regions agree, so A·B + A·B̄ + Ā·B = A + B.
alt: A two-set Venn diagram with sets A and B; A together with B-not-A covers the same three regions as A or B.
description: The four regions of the diagram are A only, both, B only and neither.
A + Ā·B takes all of A and the part of B outside A.
Together that is A only, both and B only: exactly A ∪ B.

checks.name: A + B covers the same 3 regions
